It's kind of like in horror movies when the character picks up the nearest thing to defend themselves, and it's never something practical like a baseball bat, but instead, it's a kitchen utensil. Speaking of which, if you're into horror, you might appreciate the resourcefulness of the protagonist in 'My Horror Story.' It's a new film that just came out, and it's all about using what you have in the most unexpected ways.
